title: House Cleaning Checklist Estimate Worksheet
subtitle: Residential House Cleaning: prices observed scope, options, and exclusions.
description: House Cleaning Checklist Estimate Worksheet covers room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item. The home-cleaning service coordinator records Residential House Cleaning observed scope, costs, options, and terms. House Cleaning Checklist Estimate Worksheet keeps Residential House Cleaning exceptions visible until the home-cleaning service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use House Cleaning Checklist Estimate Worksheet at residence, room sequence, access point, supply area, and excluded space. Document room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item identity before Residential House Cleaning begins. Compare room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item findings with stated Residential House Cleaning criteria; route unresolved Residential House Cleaning issues to cleaning quality reviewer.

sections.title: Estimate assumptions and customer decision
sections.guidance: Resolve open Residential House Cleaning conditions; have home-cleaning service coordinator assign the next Residential House Cleaning owner and transfer its retained record.

blocks.label: Pricing assumptions, exclusions, and retained evidence
items: Unknown spill, sharp, pest, or hazardous material
Fragile or damaged item without direction
Restricted room, privacy, or security boundary
Requested result requires restoration beyond cleaning
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential House Cleaning when an unknown exposure, damage, access, privacy, security, or scope boundary remains. Retain the available Residential House Cleaning proof and route unresolved room, surface, fixture, furnishing, requested task, and protected personal item scope to home-cleaning service coordinator.
